facts.fact: Clement 提议去工匠工坊打听消息；Moyna 与他同去，Clement 觉得她有 Ysabel 那种急切的行动力
facts.anchor: Clement was the one who had suggested talking to the artificers in the first place

facts.fact: Moyna 直问 Clement 是否爱上 Ysabel、是否与她上床、是否想与她上床
facts.anchor: Were you in love with her? Fucking her? Wanted to fuck her? What?

facts.fact: Moyna 承认自己跟 Jehan 上过床，并称这是 record（明说）的事
facts.anchor: “Who I have fucked, for the record,” said Moyna.

facts.fact: 工坊内发生爆炸；Clement 治疗昏迷的女工匠 Joley（脑震荡），嘱咐 Decroy 让她睡两小时，两天后到庭院诊所复查
facts.anchor: Let her sleep a couple of hours if you can, then send her home to rest.

facts.fact: Decroy 抱怨院长 Brodier 把大考所需的一切硬塞到教学剧场、限一小时内完成，因为二号考室昨天不能用（因 Ysabel）
facts.anchor: make us cram all the Grand Exam necessaries onto the Teaching Theatre yesterday

facts.fact: Decroy 说自己当晚在 Rondelle 待得最晚，日落后又待了不超过一小时；proctor geas 与计时器共鸣，午夜生效，门也在那时魔法上锁并设结界
facts.anchor: a resonance with the timekeeper, too. It would have come into play at midnight

facts.fact: Moyna 说凶手若也是治疗师就不会被判死，而是终身劳役契约——Sieuxerr 可把其劳力卖到任何地方，终身囚禁般看管
facts.anchor: We’re too precious. It’s a life-bond instead.

facts.fact: Clement 推断 Ysabel 至少日落一小时后才死在二号考室；他们搜遍五年级宿舍公共区找笔记本，没找到，认为凶手已拿走、烧掉或扔进河里
facts.anchor: on the floor of Exam Chamber Two until at least an hour past sundown
